title: OriginalityTransformer
description: Schema for defining functional originality mapping and worldview re-attribution rules.

worldview_reattribution.description: Text describing how the core magic system is attributed to a completely different cause (e.g. ancient ruins instead of gods).

source_feature_type.description: The category of the source feature being converted (e.g., weapon, skill, resource, plot-node).

deep_function.description: The narrative purpose served by this feature (e.g., limiting combat escalation, acting as a shield, providing a deadline).

mechanism_category.description: The abstract genre archetype of this mechanism (e.g., evolutionary-skill, time-accelerated-inventory, external-mentor).

required_transformation.description: Detailed guidelines on how to morph the mechanics of this feature.

new_worldview_attribution.description: How the morphed feature is attributed within the new world logic.

forbidden_similarity_patterns.description: Specific structural setups that look too similar to the original and are forbidden.
